request.notes: Lens sends `tags` only, always with `expected_version` (REQUIREMENTS §10.2): `tags` REPLACES the note's whole list (null/omit preserves it, `[]` clears it), so Lens first reads the note (`lithos_read(id, max_length=1)` — a truncated read keeps the full frontmatter, `metadata.version` included), edits that list, and sends it with the version it read. The canonical request is the vendored `lithos_read` `influx_archive_terminal` note (version 2) with `influx:rejected:ai-coding` appended — every other tag byte-for-byte as read. Also accepted, never sent by Lens: `title` (a rename may collide — `slug_collision`), `status` (active|archived|quarantined), `metadata` (an additive per-key merge; null deletes a key; `{}` is no change). At least one of title/tags/status/metadata must be given. `id` goes through the note resolver: a full id or an unambiguous prefix of at least 6 characters. `agent` is the attributed writer — Lens passes the OPERATOR. The body is never read into or out of the request; a successful patch bumps `version` and emits `note.updated` with `{id, title, path}`.
